summary: 12 games researched in depth, 7 kept (all medium confidence): Racing v Real Madrid (Madrid 79%), Amed v Eyüpspor (Amed 76.5%), Trabzonspor v Gaziantep (75%), Lyon v Angers (67%), Lazio v Cagliari (64.5%), STVV v OH Leuven (56%), Lommel v Gent (Gent 54.5%, draw 25.5%, so draw no bet only). Excluded: Como v Venezia (5–6 changes before the Champions League, goalkeeper reported differently), Excelsior v Twente (Twente right-back Van Rooij doubtful), Charleroi v La Louvière (Hainaut derby, behind closed doors), Frankfurt v Hamburg (Bornauw a game-time decision), Kasımpaşa v Beşiktaş (conflicting reports on Černý).

checks.team_news: Racing: LB Jorge Salinas suspended (5th yellow). Andrés Martín (muscle) is OUT of the 22-man squad (FutbolFantasy, 31 Oct 13:09). Prati and Almeida are both in the squad, and FutbolFantasy says Prati trained normally; SI and Eurosport had listed him as a doubt earlier. Backup GK Eriksson (shoulder) is in the squad; starter Agirrezabala is not in doubt. Real Madrid: Vinícius serves game 3 of a 4-match ban. Rodrygo (knee), Asencio (tibia) and Mendy are out. Valverde is not in the squad; OKDiario says tests ruled out an injury and he stays home to recover, and Mourinho said 'mañana Fede no inicia el partido'. Courtois is back from flu and in the squad (Courtois, Lunin, Mestre) and trained normally. Güler had a minor overload but is in the squad. Starting11 still lists Courtois as 'out' in its team news, but its own crowd check keeps him in the XI and every other source starts him.
checks.lineups: Racing: EFE (via Infobae), FutbolFantasy and Sports Mole agree on Agirrezabala; Mantilla, Pablo Ramón, Belocian, Aarón Martín; Iván Martín, Prati; Vicente, Canales; Zabiri. Pablo García is the likely replacement for Andrés Martín. Madrid: OKDiario (1 Nov), Eurosport, FutbolFantasy and Starting11 mostly agree on Courtois; Dumfries, Konaté/Rüdiger, Huijsen, Cucurella; Tchouaméni, Bernardo; Güler, Bellingham, Diomande; Mbappé. That is about 2–3 changes from the Clásico, and the GK and Valverde changes are forced. EFE differs: Courtois; Dumfries, Rüdiger, Huijsen, Carreras; Bernardo, Camavinga; Endrick, Bellingham, Diomande; Mbappé. That is 6 changes in total, 4 by choice. So the sources disagree on how much Mourinho rotates.
checks.rotation: Madrid: last game was the 2-1 win at Barcelona on 25 Oct. They were not in the Copa round, so they had a full week's rest. Next is AEK Athens away in the UCL on Wed 4 Nov (17:45Z), then Valencia away on Sat 7 Nov. Mourinho complained about 'tres partidos con tres viajes en siete días' and said 'No tengo un once tipo'. EFE expects him to change the XI again, and OKDiario expects 'cambios medidos' without breaking the structure. He has not explicitly announced rotation. Racing: played the Copa del Rey on 29 Oct (2-0 at Ribadesella) with mostly reserves (FutbolFantasy), so their regulars are fresh. Next is Málaga away on 7 Nov.
checks.motivation: La Liga 2026-27 matchday 11, confirmed on ESPN esp.1 and in the Spanish press. Not a Copa tie; Racing's Copa game was on 29 Oct. Madrid are 3rd on 24 pts from 10 games, behind Barça (30 from 11) and Atlético (28 from 11), so they need the points. Newly promoted Racing are 15th on 11 pts, 2 above 18th-placed Getafe (9). They are unbeaten at home and Mourinho said they deserve respect. Not a derby. Mourinho was appointed on 11 Jun 2026 and José Alberto López is long-serving, so no manager change in the last 14 days.
checks.form: Understat, last 10 league games. Madrid: W8 L2, goals 25-10, xG 25.2 (2.52/g), xGA 11.3 (1.13/g). Away: 3W 2L (lost at Betis 0-1 and Atlético 1-2), xG 2.35 and xGA 1.40 per game. They have won 5 in a row in all competitions, including the UCL wins over Roma (4-3) and Leipzig (4-1). Racing: W3 D2 L5, goals 15-26 (the league's worst defence), xG 14.3, xGA 21.4. At home they are W3 D2 (2-2 v Villarreal, 3-2 v Elche, 2-1 v Alavés, 2-2 v Valencia, 2-1 v Espanyol), goals 11-8, xG 2.03 and xGA 1.29 per game, and they scored 2 in every home game. Away they are 0/5 with goals 4-18.
checks.h2h: ESPN lists the last 5 meetings (2010–2012) as Madrid 4 wins, 1 draw (0-0 at El Sardinero, Sept 2011), Racing 0. SI says Madrid won 9 of the last 10 and Racing have not beaten them since April 2007. There has been no meeting for 14 years, so this tells us little. Style: Racing are open and attacking (23 shots v Espanyol) but leak goals, which points to a high-scoring game. DraftKings' total line is 4.5, and BTTS yes is 1.55 at Retabet.
checks.odds: DraftKings (ESPN API): Racing +900, draw +650, Madrid -450, having opened +700/+550/-390. De-vigged proportionally that is 9.5/12.7/77.8%; with the power method 8.3/11.3/80.5%. Bet365 AU (Stats Insider, updated 1 Nov): 11.00/8.50/1.18, de-vigged 8.6/11.1/80.2%. Retabet: Madrid 1.22 (Eurosport, 30 Oct). Polymarket 24h: Madrid 0.805→0.815 (+1.2%), draw 0.115→0.115, Racing 0.085→0.075. Every move has shortened Madrid, which fits the news of Courtois returning and Andrés Martín being ruled out, so no unexplained move. Stake and Rainbet both returned 403, so no price was seen.

ClubElo was unreachable (connection reset / 403). Every model has Madrid below the market (68–76%) and the draw above it (13–20%).
checks.venue_weather: Estadio El Sardinero, Santander, 15:15Z (16:15 CET). Short domestic trip for Madrid, but it starts three away games in seven days. Open-Meteo for 15–17Z: 16–17°C, 0 mm rain (0% chance), wind 7–9 km/h with gusts up to 17 km/h. No pitch problems reported.

games.reason: Starting from Polymarket (7.3/11.3/81.4), I moved Madrid down 2.4 points and the draw up 1.7, for these cited reasons. Madrid are without Vinícius (suspended), Valverde (ruled out by Mourinho) and Rodrygo. Some rotation is likely before the UCL trip to AEK on Wednesday; EFE has 4 changes by choice, including Camavinga, Endrick and Carreras. Racing are unbeaten at home and scored 2 in every home league game, with home xGA only 1.29. Madrid concede away (xGA 1.40/g; lost at Betis and Atlético). Every model is lower on Madrid (68–76%) and higher on the draw (13–20%). The moves stay small because the bookmakers agree with the market: power de-vig gives about 80–82% and both books have shortened Madrid. Racing also have the league's worst defence (26 conceded, xGA 2.14/g) and lose Andrés Martín and LB Salinas, while Madrid average 2.5 xG/g and have won 5 straight. The draw at 13% is well under 25%, so a straight Madrid win is allowed. Confidence is medium, not high, because lineup sources disagree on how much Mourinho rotates and Courtois is just back from flu. If the official XI (out about 14:15Z) shows 5+ changes by choice, or Courtois not in goal, drop this leg.
games.main_risk: With a rotated Madrid side and no Vinícius or Valverde, Racing score at home as they have in every home game this season. Madrid's shaky away defence then lets in a late equaliser for a 2-2 or 1-1, like Racing's home draws with Villarreal and Valencia.

Eyüpspor are 18th on 3 pts (1-0-8) in a relegation fight, and Fotomaç reported a FIFA transfer ban on them (16–17 Oct). Not a derby. Eyüpspor coach Mustafa Dalcı was appointed on 29 Sep (beIN), 33 days ago, so outside the 14-day rule. Besnik Hasi has been coaching Amed throughout.
checks.form: Amed (ESPN): won 3-0 Erzurum, lost 0-2 Kocaelispor, won 2-1 Trabzonspor, drew 2-2 Kasımpaşa, won 5-0 Başakşehir, won 3-2 Beşiktaş, drew 2-2 Gençlerbirliği, won 1-0 Konyaspor (86' winner), won 2-1 at Samsunspor (84' winner). Eyüpspor: lost 0-1 Beşiktaş, lost 0-1 Gaziantep, won 2-1 Alanyaspor, then six straight league defeats (0-3, 0-2, 0-8, 0-4, 0-2, 0-1). Eyüpspor have won only 1 of 5 visits to Amed (2D 2L), in April 2009. These are all old lower-division games: 3 of 8 were draws, 2 of 5 in Diyarbakır. Style: Amed are strong in attack and have the most goals from outside the box among Europe's top 10 leagues (beIN); Eyüpspor barely create anything.

games.reason: Starting from Polymarket (0.784 / 0.143 / 0.074), I moved 1.9 points from home to draw. The bookmakers I could read (DraftKings, BetMGM, Unibet, TonyBet) put the draw at 0.158–0.170 and the home win at 0.736–0.751. Amed are also missing their striker Diagne (red card) and defender Dellova (bans) plus Sor and Demir (injured). Their last two wins needed late goals (86' v Konyaspor, 84' v Samsunspor), and they let leads slip at Gençlerbirliği and Kasımpaşa. I kept the home win high because the gap is huge: Amed have won all 5 home games (14-3, xG 1.8 for / 0.9 against), while Eyüpspor have lost six league games in a row, scored 2 in 9 and none in 4 away games, have xG 0.8 for / 1.7 against, and have a transfer ban. The Kickoff.co.uk model has Amed at 87%. Rotation, derby, manager-change, weather and venue checks are all clean, and the 24h move matches DraftKings. Confidence is medium, not high: only one named predicted XI was available, the absence list comes from one source, Amed's midweek cup status is unconfirmed, and the books are below Polymarket. The draw at 0.16 is under the 25% limit for a straight win.
games.main_risk: Without Diagne, Amed struggle to break down a deep, desperate Eyüpspor side and the game ends 0-0 or 1-1. Evidence: two of Eyüpspor's league defeats were only 0-1 (Beşiktaş, Gaziantep), and Amed's last two wins came with 86th- and 84th-minute goals.

checks.rotation: Trabzonspor last played at Rizespor on Mon 26 Oct (won 4-3). Next they host SC Freiburg in the Conference League on Thu 5 Nov, then go to Alanyaspor on 8 Nov before the international break. None of the four previews found any talk of rotating. Gaziantep last played on 24 Oct and next play Kasımpaşa on Fri 6 Nov, with no midweek game.
checks.motivation: Trabzonspor are 3rd on 19 pts from 9 games, 6 behind leaders Galatasaray (25 from 10). They are chasing a 7th straight win under Thomas Reis (appointed 17 Sep, 45 days ago) and a 5th straight home league win. Gaziantep are 14th/15th on 8 pts, level with 16th, so they are in a relegation scrap. Orhan Ak has been their coach since 4 Sep, 58 days ago. Ak is a former Trabzonspor coach, but this is no derby or rivalry. Both sides have something to play for.
checks.form: Trabzonspor: 6 straight wins in all competitions (Galatasaray 4-0, at Samsunspor 3-0, at KuPS 4-2, Beşiktaş 2-0, Hearts 2-0, at Rizespor 4-3). League record 6-1-2, goals 22-8. Home league 4/4, goals 13-1. FotMob xG in 9 league games is 17.8 for and 14.1 against, about 4 xPts below actual points, and the defence allows chances (conceded 3 at Rize). Gaziantep: 5 league games without a win (D 0-0 Fenerbahçe, then losses 0-2 at Kocaelispor, 0-3 vs Çorum, 1-2 at Başakşehir, 1-3 vs Erzurum), 2-10 on goals over the last 5. FotMob xG 10.6 for, 14.6 against. Away record W2 D0 L2, goals 6-6.
checks.h2h: SportsGambler: Trabzonspor are unbeaten in the last 10 meetings (7 wins, 3 draws). The latest was a 2-1 Trabzonspor win at Gaziantep on 22 Feb 2026. The last meeting at Papara Park ended 1-1 (Sep 2025). Before that, Trabzonspor scored 3+ in each of their 4 previous home meetings (Sports Mole). So 3 of the last 10 meetings ended level.

The reasons: the de-vigged DraftKings (0.749/0.146) and BetMGM (0.739/0.157) prices, and the Statz model (70/17/13), all rate the home win lower and the draw higher than Polymarket, which has just moved +5.4%. The last h2h at Papara Park was 1-1 and 3 of the last 10 meetings were draws. For the same reason, Polymarket's 0.775 may overstate the home win compared with the bookmakers' ~0.74-0.75.

The sources also split on RB (Smolcic or Couto), the midfield pair (Ricci, Milla, Perrone), RW (Couto or Da Cunha) and LW (Baturina or Caqueret). checks.rotation: Como play 3 games in 8 days: W 3-1 at Torino (Tue 27 Oct), this game, then at Lens in the Champions League (Wed 4 Nov), then at Inter (8 Nov). Against the Torino XI, Fantamaster's and SOS Fanta's predicted XIs have 5 changes and Sports Mole's has 6. Sports Mole says Fabregas 'may choose to rotate'. Davide Nicola was appointed at Venezia on 14 Oct (18 days ago, just outside the 14-day rule). He won 1-0 against Napoli on his debut, then lost both games since. Fabregas's job is secure.
checks.form: Como in Serie A: D1-1 Udinese, W2-1 Napoli, W4-1 Genoa, W2-1 Parma, L0-2 Frosinone, D0-0 Roma, W3-1 Fiorentina, W2-0 Sassuolo, W3-1 Torino. That is 17 scored and 8 conceded. Understat xG is 20.5 for and 13.5 against (2.28 and 1.50 per game). At home they are 2W 1D with xG 7.9 for and 3.0 against. In the Champions League they beat Leipzig 4-1 and Manchester United 4-1 and lost 2-3 at Feyenoord. Venezia are 1W 8L, 6 scored and 19 conceded. Their xG is 15.6 for and 20.9 against (1.73 and 2.32 per game), so they have scored far fewer goals than their chances suggest. They have 0 points in 4 away games (3 scored, 9 conceded) and have drawn no games this season.

games.reason: Excluded on the rotation and goalkeeper rules. Como are expected to make 5-6 changes from Tuesday's Torino XI (Fantamaster, SOS Fanta, Sports Mole), with a Champions League trip to Lens 3 days later. Fabregas talked about rotation and said Douvikas might rest on Sunday. The starting GK is reported differently: Butez per Fantamaster, SOS Fanta and Sports Mole, Sánchez per Sky and Statz. Venezia are bottom with 1W 8L and no away points. The market estimate starts at Polymarket's 74.65/15.7/9.65. I moved the home win down 2 points and the draw up 1.5. games.main_risk: A rotated Como side, playing its third game in 8 days and thinking about Lens on Wednesday, dominates the ball but fails to score. Venezia, compact under Nicola in a 3-5-2 and creating chances (xG 1.73 per game), then nick a goal for a 1-1 draw. The last meeting at the Sinigaglia ended exactly that way, 1-1 with a 95th-minute Venezia penalty.
